Positioned above retail space, the home opens directly onto a large landscaped courtyard with your own private patio. Comfortable practical layout with 2 well-sized bedrooms, 2 full baths, flexible den ideal for a home office, plus a large entry flex room for storage, pantry or gear. Located on W Broadway above London Drugs, surrounded by cafés, shops, restaurants, groceries and transit. Easy access to Kits Beach, waterfront routes, Downtown and UBC. Tenant insurance required at move-in. $200 move-in fee paid to Strata BCS667.
